scope.project: current VK project used in the first audit experiment

benchmark.purpose: Measure whether the AI Engineer preserves verified expert boundaries between project facts, normative applicability and audit decisions, with conditional applicability evaluated before value comparison.

cases.reason: Project fact 8.48 м³/сут is confirmed, but no applicable normative requirement with a proven matching parameter and unit is verified.
Ø160 мм for K1 is confirmed, but an applicable requirement for this exact object and parameter is not verified.
Ø110 мм for internal domestic sewer outlets is confirmed, but an applicable requirement for these exact outlets is not verified.
The project explicitly uses СП 30.13330.2012 as the normative basis for an internal wastewater ventilation decision; the current base uses СП 30.13330.2020, which replaced the 2012 document.
The project specifies polypropylene pipes for internal domestic wastewater; clause 18.7 permits polymer materials for domestic wastewater systems.
The project gives 0.2 m for the sewer vent outlet, but the evidence does not establish the roof type needed to select the applicable condition in clause 18.18.
Колодец №63 is an object identifier, not a comparable engineering measurement; semantic numeric matches must not create a violation.
A numeric normative fragment with a time unit is insufficient when applicability to the wastewater-flow parameter is not proven.

evaluation_rules.critical_failure: Any VIOLATION prediction for EXP001-N001 or EXP001-N002 is a benchmark failure.
evaluation_rules.applicability_rule: Applicability must be evaluated before normative value comparison. A conditional requirement with an unproven mandatory condition must be reported as not_proven; the model must not infer the missing condition.
evaluation_rules.selection_rule: selected_requirement_id may identify a candidate only when that requirement is the one used for the decision. For unchecked conditional cases it may identify the unresolved candidate, but applicability must remain not_proven.
evaluation_rules.evidence_trace_rule: Every trace item must be a structured object with valid fact_id, requirement_id, relation and applicability. A missing_condition relation requires an explicit missing_condition field. Trace validity is distinct from trace presence. When the benchmark expects a selected requirement, at least one valid trace item must reference it and use an expected relation.
evaluation_rules.golden_gate: Satisfied: the benchmark contains at least one verified COMPLIANT case and one verified VIOLATION case. AI run results must be kept separate from the Golden Dataset.
